name: TalonsCove
description: A wedding and reception center at TalonsCove Golf Club in Saratoga Springs, on the west shore of Utah Lake, with a garden rotunda for ceremonies, a veranda and outdoor fire bowl, a 3,000-square-foot ballroom with a chandelier and fireplace, and a bar and lounge.
